tenderSchedule.title: Feeder level Solarization under CM-SKY
tenderSchedule.description: Selection of Solar Power Generators (SPGs) on the basis of Build, Own & Operate (BOO) for Design, Survey, Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning, Operation & Maintenance of grid connected distributed solar power plants for feeder level solarization of selected Agriculture/Mixed Load feeders at various Sub-Stations (SS) with aggregate capacity of 40MW in MESCOM jurisdiction, its associated 11kV lines to connect the plant with concerned SS and Remote Monitoring System (RMS) of solar power plants through RESCO mode, under Non-CFA category for 25 years under CM-SKY (Mukhya Manthri Soura Krishi Yojane) Scheme
tenderSchedule.locationName: MESCOM Superintending Engineer Projects Corporate Office Managaluru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidder should not upload his rate separately in e-portal other than in the Item wise bid commercial offer, else the bids will be rejected
The Bid prepared by the Bidder and all correspondence and documents relating to the bid, exchanged by the Bidder and the Owner shall be written in English language only
All the terms and conditions are as per the tender documents uploaded

Mangalore Electricity Supply Company Limited takes no responsibility for delay, due to any cyber or other computer related problems or postal delay. Further, MESCOM reserves the right to reject any or all the Bids without assigning reasons thereof and shall bear no liability whatsoever consequent upon such a decision

Notwithstanding anything stated above, MESCOM reserves the right to assess the capacity of the bidder to perform contract, should the circumstances warrant such an assessment in the overall interest of MESCOM.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall propose commercially established technology only and at least one project not less than 1MW capacity based on this technology is successfully operational for at least one year

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Undertaking for Technical Capacity (Technology) as per the Format provided in Annexure-IV

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder can be a single business entity, Government Owned entity OR, Consortium of up to Three (3) members, with one of the member as a Lead Bidder

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- In case of Consortium, Joint Bidding Agreement as per Annexure-XVI

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: a) Company incorporated in India under the Companies Act, 1956/2013 including any amendment thereto b) LLP incorporated in India under the Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Act, 2008 including any amendment thereto c) Firm registered / unregistered under Partnership Act, 1932 in India d) Firm registered under Societies Registration Act, 1860 / The Karnataka Societies Registration Act, 1960 in India e) Sole Proprietor incorporated in India. In case of Consortium, all the members must fulfill this requirement and submit the documents as per this RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents as per RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must have the required GST Registration. In case of Consortium, all the members must fulfill this requirement

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GSTregistration certificate(s) with legible GSTIN

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should engage Electrical Contractor having license of minimum Class-1 grade for Electrical works in Karnataka or any other State

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Undertaking regarding engaging minimum Class-1 Electrical Contractor as per Annexure-IX

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not be Blacklisted/ Defaulted against any work/service against any of the previous orders placed by any State/Central Government/Public Sector Undertakings/ Private Sector as on the date of submission of bid. In case of Consortium, all the members must fulfill this requirement.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Undertaking as per Annexure-X. In case of Consortium, all the members must submit the undertaking as per Annexure-X

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not be acted in concert or in collusion with any other Bidder or other person(s) and also not done any act, deed or thing which is or could be regarded as anti-competitive. In case of Consortium, all the members must fulfill this requirement

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Undertaking for Anti-Collusion as per Annexure-XI. In case of Consortium, all the members must submit the undertaking as per Annexure-XI

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should submit a Power of Attorney (POA) authorizing a person to sign the documents on behalf of the Bidder, submit technical, commercial information and attend meetings on behalf of the Bidder

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Sole Bidder to upload POA as per Annexure-XIV. In case of Consortium, POA for lead member as per Annexure-XV

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Any bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the bidder is registered with the competent authority

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration certificate issued by the competent authority and Self-declaration certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have positive Minimum net worth of INR 96 lakhs per MW as on 31st March 2026. In case of Consortium, all the partners shall collectively meet this financial criterion. Ex: If the net worth of a Bidder is INR 960 Lakhs as on 31st March 2026, then the bidder is eligible to quote for Projects covering upto maximum of 10MW capacity only.
